name: Organic Warm
tagline: Oat, clay, and olive. Soft shapes with a firm hand.
description: A warm, tactile system for brands made by people. Earthy colors, large radii and arched shapes, a characterful serif for headlines, and a clean sans for reading. Compositions are asymmetric so pages feel arranged by hand, not generated.

do: Use 28px radius on cards and images, full radius on buttons and chips
Mask hero and product images with an arch (rounded top only) or a pill shape
Underline one key word per headline with the hand-drawn SVG stroke in clay
Offset compositions: image and text blocks overlap or sit on different baselines
Use olive for success and secondary emphasis, clay for the main action
dont: Do not use pure white or pure black
Do not use sharp corners on interactive elements
Do not use script or handwriting fonts
Do not place three equal cards in a row; vary size and shape
Do not use stock-photo style placeholders; draw shapes with tokens instead

components.name: Button
components.notes: Full-radius pills. Primary clay; secondary is a 1.5px cocoa outline; ghost is text with the hand-drawn underline on hover.

components.name: Input
components.notes: 20px radius fields on surface with a line border, label above in 500 weight. Error turns the border danger and adds a gentle message.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Pill-shaped select with a soft chevron, used for class type.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Rounded 6px checkbox in clay. Switch is a fat pill with an olive track when on.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Pills with tinted surface fills; "Few spots left" uses clay text on a clay-tinted surface.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Product card: arched image shape drawn with tokens, serif name, price, and a short material note.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Serif wordmark, links, and a pill "Book a class" action. Mobile menu is a details disclosure with large tap rows.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: 28px radius sheet that slides up from the bottom on mobile, centered on desktop, with a soft shadow.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Class schedule: rounded container, alternating surface rows, date, class, teacher, spots left, price.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Studio features: one tall arched image tile, a quote tile, a price tile, a map-like tile, and a hours list.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: A drawn bowl shape in clay, a warm headline, and a pill action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Pill-shaped surface toast with an olive dot for success and a clay dot for errors.
